gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-vend-sans: Bushcraft stretches out wide and loose, every curve drawn without a swell. Vend Sans is the plain sans that does the opposite job: its open, ruler-straight lines and tall lowercase handle the steady reading while the heading handles the personality.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-yaldevi: Yaldevi reads wide and clear, its lowercase oversized and its e opening to the right. Next to Bushcraft's sealed, artistic letters, a longer passage in it would feel like stepping out of a tightly packed room into daylight.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-abeezee: Capture It towers, with a tall x-height and letters almost sealed shut. ABeeZee is the plain sans that follows, its terminals finishing well clear of the stem, so a longer passage feels light and approachable after such a tight heading.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-aldrich: Capture It stands tall and commanding, its letters nearly sealed and free of any thick-thin flicker. Aldrich, a plain sans with cupped round letters and an x-height close to the capitals, offers the pair's strongest quality: a firm, urban heading met by a body that opens up.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-alexandria: Those almost-sealed letters and towering x-height make Capture It instantly urban and forceful. And Alexandria, a sans with wide open c terminals, lets a longer passage breathe, so the eye gets room after the heading's dense shapes.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-amiko: Capture It packs a towering x-height with no thick-thin flicker, so it hits like a slab. But Amiko's terminals flare outward like tongs, and that open, modern body against the sealed heading is the strongest thing about this sans-serif pairing.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-anek-bangla: Capture It brings a towering x-height and urban, commanding letters that sit almost completely sealed shut. Anek Bangla, a plain sans, loosens everything with wide s curves.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-anek-devanagari: Nearly sealed letters and arms and legs of constant width give Capture It a commanding, urban punch. But Anek Devanagari, a plain sans with distinctly open letter mouths, is the one built to carry the text while the heading makes the statement.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-anek-gujarati: Anek Gujarati has a gaping c opening and lowercase that rivals its capitals. Capture It, tall and nearly sealed, locks in above it, so the page moves from a tight urban shout to a plain sans that speaks easily.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Tight, towering and urban, that is Capture It, whose letters are nearly sealed and show no thick-thin flicker. Capture It does the loud work; Anek Gurmukhi, a sans with big open counters, does the welcoming.
